item.description:

item.description:

item.title: Indie Brief, Friday 2 October
item.description:
Good morning, this is Indie Brief for Friday 2 October.
Pakistan has made history at the Academy Awards by selecting a documentary as its official entry for Best International Feature. Deadline reports that Mo Naqvi's Hanging By a Wire, a nonfiction action thriller about a major news event from 2023, is the first documentary Pakistan has ever chosen for this distinction.

item.description:
Good morning, this is Indie Brief for Thursday 1 October.

item.title: Indie Brief, Wednesday 30 September
item.description:
Good morning, this is Indie Brief for Wednesday 30 September.
Deadline reports that Channel 4 is teaming with the Stroke Association on a new documentary series called Trauma: My Broken Brain. The series follows three young stroke survivors through their recovery journey, exploring the psychological and physical aftermath of stroke.
